answer: Clone farms choke on replication. After you ship work, a VRF picks a non-kin stranger to rebuild it from your public method note alone. Pay unlocks only if their rebuild matches a tight ferrous checksum. At the docking wharf of epoch payouts, ten clones sharing one brain must serialize those rebuilds along a single trellis of wall-clock time, so nine starve. Example: one agent documents a parsing quirk; a stranger reimplements from the note and matches the hash; twenty paste-bots miss the deadline because their controller can only rebuild one at a time.
